title: Open-Meteo ERA5 archive — June 2016–2025, Durban (-29.8579, 31.0292)
claims: Open-Meteo ERA5 archive for the grid cell at 29.8579 S, 31.0292 E, elevation 21 m, over the 300 June days from 2016 to 2025: mean daily maximum 22.5 °C and mean daily minimum 13.9 °C.
The same query gives mean precipitation of 0.8 mm per day; 47 of the 300 June days (15.7%) had at least 1 mm.
These are reanalysis statistics for the Durban grid cell, not official race data and not measurements from the race route.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直接查询 Open-Meteo archive API，取 2016–2025 年 6 月共 300 天，按 daily time 过滤 06 月后计算均值；坐标与海拔取自 Open-Meteo geocoding 的 Durban 条目。

claimVerification.note: API 返回 300 个 6 月日值；temperature_2m_max 均值 22.5，temperature_2m_min 均值 13.9。
precipitation_sum 均值 0.8 mm/day；≥1 mm 的日数 47/300 = 15.7%。
网格再分析数据，非赛事官方观测；Durban 海拔 21 m，湿度与海风不在该三变量中。
